Fractional firepower, portfolio proof.

Seasoned operators drop straight into your portfolio companies, and every growth plan opens with an honest read on the numbers the business actually produces.

Seats we fill
Fractional CEO, CFO and COO

An experienced executive takes the seat, owns the number, and reports to the sponsor on a fixed cadence.

Plans we build
Value creation, measured monthly

Every initiative carries an owner, a date and a figure, so progress is read from the books rather than the deck.

Results we prove
Profit, growth and new customers

Margin, cash conversion and pipeline are tracked against the thesis, and reported honestly when they miss.

Most portfolio misses are seat problems, never thesis problems. We fill the seat and we prove the number.

What the sponsor gets

A named operator inside the business within weeks, not a quarter. A value-creation plan written against the books the company already keeps. One monthly pack that reads the same every month, so trend is visible rather than argued.

When a number misses, the pack says so plainly and names what is being done about it. Honest reporting protects the thesis; flattering reporting costs you the exit.

What the company gets

Experience in the chair without a permanent hire, and a management team that keeps the systems after we leave. Workflows get documented, the close gets faster, and the people who carry the numbers learn to explain them.

Training comes with the build, never as an upsell, because a system nobody can run is a liability rather than a deliverable.

Where to start

Your first look costs nothing at all.

Send us the shape of the problem and we return real findings, a scope in writing and a fixed number. No open-ended hours, and no surprises once the work begins.
